blocks.text: 🪝 India Tops World in IPO Count, Ranks 3rd in Funds Raised (SEBI Annual Report FY26). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: High domestic equity issuance volume reinforces India's position in global capital markets.
Public Shareholding Timeline: Largest listed companies given up to 10 years to reach mandatory 25% minimum public shareholding.
Pre-IPO ESOPs: Founders permitted to retain pre-IPO Employee Stock Option Plans.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
